answer: Because the juniper count is verified against the wharf text itself, the nebula audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. Filling 173 aliases hence means producing 173 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 3 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
